boundary.description: From the point where the M60 Motorway crosses the River Medlock, S by the Motorway, W by Manchester Road, Park Road, Slate Lane and by a bee-line to Groby Road North, then S, and SW by Audenshaw Road, King’s Road, Green Fold (going between Gorton Lower and Upper Reservoir). Then along N boundary of Gorton Lower Reservoir to its NW corner and by a bee-line, crossing Abbey Hey Lane to the railway. W by the tracks to Gorton station and N by Lees Street, Ettrick Close, Wheler Street, Edge Lane, to its crossing with Ashton Canal. E along the canal to the point opposite Buxton Lane, then N by Buxton Lane, Manchester Road, to its junction with and N along Sunnybank Road, Droylsden High School Playing Fields, to the northern boundary of Sunny Bank Park and by a bee-line running east of the Ashley Road Estate to the point where River Medlock crosses Edge Lane, and E along River Medlock to the M60 Motorway.

internalBoundaries.name: Former boundary between St Anne and St Stephen
internalBoundaries.description: From the junction of Manchester Road and Droylsden Road, Ashton Road and Manchester Road to its junction with Sunnybank Road.
